name: Kaizen Agent Platform · Round 1
domainSummary: A governed MCP capability platform generated from product-owned API contracts, forwarding calls to authoritative services while preserving identity, RBAC, replay-safe writes, auditability, correlation, telemetry, and failure handling.
evidenceBoundary: Use only high-level architecture supported by the project walkthrough; do not invent private endpoints, customers, metrics, or confidential workflows.

researchSources.title: Project walkthrough: Kaizen Agent Platform
researchSources.use: Repository-backed ownership, capability contracts, generated tools, service authority, RBAC, safe writes, and telemetry.

assets.name: Kaizen Agent Platform · Canonical Amplification
assets.controlledVariable: refine and amplify the accepted baseline geometry while preserving its defining silhouette; emphasize contract-owned capability discovery
assets.thesis: The accepted identity is tested at its most resolved supporting-landmark scale. This version emphasizes contract-owned capability discovery.

assets.name: Kaizen Agent Platform · Process Spine
assets.controlledVariable: recompose the landmark along a clear sequential service spine with repeated but unequal chambers; emphasize generated typed tool surfaces
assets.thesis: A visible spatial sequence makes the project's process legible without arrows or diagrams. This version emphasizes generated typed tool surfaces.

assets.name: Kaizen Agent Platform · Exchange Bridge
assets.controlledVariable: divide the major functions into unequal connected masses joined by one inhabited structural bridge; emphasize backend authority and RBAC
assets.thesis: A physical bridge tests whether handoff and exchange should dominate the identity. This version emphasizes backend authority and RBAC.

assets.name: Kaizen Agent Platform · Checkpoint Court
assets.controlledVariable: organize the building around a protected validation court with layered thresholds and one decisive exit; emphasize replay-safe guarded writes
assets.thesis: A central court makes review, validation, or adjudication the primary metaphor. This version emphasizes replay-safe guarded writes.

assets.name: Kaizen Agent Platform · Terraced Escalation
assets.controlledVariable: step the landmark upward through three or four connected terraces toward one compact focus; emphasize audit and correlation evidence
assets.thesis: Terraced hierarchy expresses staged progress and increasing commitment. This version emphasizes audit and correlation evidence.

assets.name: Kaizen Agent Platform · Modular Batch
assets.controlledVariable: build the landmark from repeatable unequal modules locked to one continuous service base; emphasize contract-owned capability discovery
assets.thesis: Repeatable modules test batch, scale, and replaceability without detached pieces. This version emphasizes contract-owned capability discovery.

assets.name: Kaizen Agent Platform · Guarded Recovery
assets.controlledVariable: place a protected core inside redundant connected routes with one visibly joined recovery annex; emphasize generated typed tool surfaces
assets.thesis: Guardrails and recovery become architectural without implying an unverified implementation. This version emphasizes generated typed tool surfaces.

assets.name: Kaizen Agent Platform · Asymmetric Landmark
assets.controlledVariable: concentrate height and mass off-center to create one singular project-scale skyline; emphasize backend authority and RBAC
assets.thesis: A deliberately asymmetric silhouette tests recognition at map scale. This version emphasizes backend authority and RBAC.

assets.name: Kaizen Agent Platform · Compact Deployment
assets.controlledVariable: compress the domain into the smallest dense, coherent project building that retains the accepted identity; emphasize replay-safe guarded writes
assets.thesis: Compression tests which visual cues are essential rather than merely decorative. This version emphasizes replay-safe guarded writes.

assets.name: Kaizen Agent Platform · Domain Synthesis
assets.controlledVariable: balance the strongest baseline, process, validation, exchange, and recovery cues in one resolved composition; emphasize audit and correlation evidence
assets.thesis: The synthesis tests a mature all-around project identity without becoming a city capital. This version emphasizes audit and correlation evidence.
